prompts.caveman:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent modular BODY sprite for a cute 2D hand drawn prehistoric action game.
Input image 1 is ONLY a style and silhouette-proportion reference: the existing caveman. Input image 2 is ONLY a body-only export reference showing no hands/feet. Redesign the CAVEMAN/HUNTER so he cannot be confused with the old bearded characters.
Create ONE centered chubby egg-shaped HEAD-AND-TORSO cutout, front view, NO arms, NO hands, NO legs, NO feet, NO weapons, NO ground shadow. Body includes head and tunic continuously like the reference; floating limbs will be supplied in engine.
Identity: youthful, friendly, mischievous hunter; huge swept-up short RUST-ORANGE hair tuft with an asymmetric jagged silhouette, NO beard and NO moustache; raised expressive eyebrows, dark oval eyes, wide confident open grin showing one big cream tooth. Warm peach skin. A simple ochre-yellow one-shoulder hide tunic with a diagonal russet leather strap and a large single ivory bone fastener; one or two broad dark hide patches, readable big shapes, small leaf-green tied scarf at the side. Compact triangular hair tuft above round face; no hat or feathers.
Match the reference's thick dark warm-brown imperfect ink contours, flat warm hand painted gouache fills with subtle paper grain, simple few broad color shapes and cute mobile-game chibi egg proportions. Crisp clear silhouette at 60 pixels high. Outer stroke about 1% of body height; no surrounding white halo.
Entire head and torso fully inside frame, generous 6% transparent padding all around, centered, body roughly 0.82 times as wide as tall. Truly transparent RGBA background. No text, labels, panels, extra characters or props.

ONE centered front-view chubby HEAD-AND-TORSO cutout, absolutely NO arms, hands, legs, feet, weapons or ground shadow. Floating limbs are supplied in the engine.
Identity: wise confident elderly tribe chief. Distinct cool SILVER-WHITE swept-back hair at both sides, a short white squared beard and broad white moustache, shrewd relaxed half-closed dark eyes and a subtle knowing smile. Rust-red wrapped headband supporting a dramatic crown of THREE BROAD SHORT FEATHERS fanning upward: teal, ivory, terracotta. Important: the fan adds width at the top, not an extremely long thin antenna. A deep TURQUOISE-TEAL layered poncho drapes across both shoulders with cream geometric hem and a central rust-red woven sash; large round ivory bone medallion. NO leopard-print yellow hide and NO brown beard. Warm tan skin.
Match reference thick dark warm-brown slightly imperfect ink outline, flat hand painted gouache fills, subtle paper grain, simple large color blocks readable at 60 pixels high. Egg-shaped head torso as one continuous sprite. Distinct horizontal shoulders and feather-fan silhouette. Body width approximately .82 of total height. Fully contained and centered with 6% transparent padding. Transparent RGBA backdrop. No text, no labels, no panels, no extra characters, no white halo.
